description: XrmToolBox tool for Dynamics 365 / Power Platform teams. Pick a form, view, JavaScript web resource, security role, command bar command, plugin step or process, select any of your saved connections or environment groups, and see which environments share the same version, where it has drifted, exactly what differs, who changed it and when, and what a deployment would overwrite. Read-only: it never changes an environment and sends no data anywhere. Export to Excel, CSV or HTML.
releaseNotes:
First release.
- Compare forms, views, web resources, security roles, classic ribbon and modern commands, plugin steps and processes (workflows, actions, business rules, business process flows, cloud flows) across any number of environments.
- Ignores environment noise (generated ids, timestamps, formatting, attribute order) before comparing.
- Groups environments by identical version, with an Aligned / Diverged assessment and a divergence level.
- Shows semantic differences (fields, columns, privileges, buttons, stepsâ€¦), a side-by-side line view, and audit information (last modified, modified by, managed).
- Deployment impact: what deploying from one environment would update, create or overwrite in the others.
- Reports missing components, missing permissions and unreachable environments per environment, without stopping the run.
- Configurable environment groups that can be exported and shared with a team.
- Several components at once: enter a list separated by ',', with automatic type detection, optional `type:` prefixes and `@table` suffixes, duplicate detection, a results grid, a component Ã— environment matrix and drill-down to each component.
- Export to Excel, CSV and HTML (single component or batch).
- Read-only by design: no writes, no external services, no stored credentials.
summary: Compare one Dataverse component across many environments and see drift before you deploy.
title: Cross-Environment Component Comparer
